S: the whole lab shrunk down and carried like luggage
Little puff pastry quiches of egg, ham and cheddar, baked in a mini muffin tray until puffed and golden.

One huge chocolate chip cookie baked in a pan at 180C for 20 minutes, cut into wedges at the table. Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, then beat in an egg. Mix in 200g flour and 150g dark chocolate chips. Press into a greased ovenproof pan and bake at 180C for 20 minutes until golden at the edges and soft in the centre. Cut into wedges.
racing round the steep streets of San Francisco

Flaky pastry cases filled with silky sweet egg custard and baked until just set and lightly caramelised on top, served warm. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets of puff pastry and press into a greased muffin tin. Whisk 3 eggs, 2 egg yolks, 80g caster sugar, 150ml milk, 100ml cream and 1 tsp vanilla, then strain. Pour into the cases until three quarters full. Bake at 220C for 15 to 18 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble and spotted brown on top. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

Thin crisp bases with garlicky tomato sauce, mozzarella, hot salami, sliced mushrooms and olives, blistered in a hot oven, with chilli flakes. Divide 1kg pizza dough into 4 and stretch into thin rounds. Mix 250ml passata with 1 crushed garlic clove, oregano and salt and spread over the bases. Top with 400g grated mozzarella, 150g sliced hot salami, 150g sliced mushrooms and a handful of olives. Bake on hot trays at 250C for 10 minutes until blistered. Finish with chilli flakes and torn basil.
W: the strange colourful quantum realm Scott gets stuck in

Four jellies made one at a time and poured in thin layers into clear glasses, each set for an hour before the next goes on, topped with whipped cream. Make up raspberry jelly with half the water and pour a thin layer into clear glasses, then chill an hour. Repeat with lime, then blue, then orange jelly, letting each set before the next goes on. Top with whipped cream just before serving.
K: Scott's two years stuck at home

Frosty mugs of fizzing root beer poured over vanilla ice cream so it foams up high, with whipped cream and a cherry. Freeze 4 glass mugs for an hour. Put 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream into each frozen mug. Tilt the mug and slowly pour in about 250ml cold root beer down the side, letting it foam up over the ice cream, then top up as the foam settles. Add a spoon of whipped cream and a cherry, and serve with a straw and a long spoon.
